items.headline: Example Regulator Proposes Settlement Change
items.summary: The regulator opened consultation on a shorter settlement cycle, with responses due on 12 May. The proposal does not specify an implementation date.

items.headline: Example Manufacturer Reportedly Tests New Process
items.summary: Example Industry Journal reported that a manufacturer has begun pilot testing. Commercial qualification remains pending and the company has not announced a production schedule.

items.headline: Example Components Raises Revenue Guidance
items.summary: Example Components lifted its full-year revenue guidance to RMB4.2–4.4bn from RMB4.0–4.2bn, citing higher shipments. Q1 net profit rose 18.25% YoY to RMB126mn on revenue of RMB980mn.
Example Networks said its pilot line remains in qualification; commercial deliveries are expected next year and no customer orders were disclosed.
